From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 3 Mar 2028 14:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula Health — DPF questionnaire and DPA annex questions

Folks — answering the technical sections now; pulling the appendix items. Key points to include in the client-facing response:

1) Cross-border / transfer approach:
- For hosted API customers we support data routing policies by region. Default behavior: customer data routed to nearest region; for EU controllers we will route to EU-hosted runtime by default.
- Where non-EU routing is required (e.g., US inference), transfers are covered by our DPA + SCCs (we can provide a signed SCC addendum) and by our transfer impact assessment (TIA) summary. We also support documented Transfer Framework controls (technical & organisational) mapped to the DPF questions.

2) KMS & encryption:
- Encryption at rest: AES-256. Customer-managed KMS supported for Dedicated and Private via AWS KMS/HSM; hosted customers can request BYOK for enterprise plans.
- In-transit: TLS1.3. KV cache keys are ephemeral; we do not persist raw prompts beyond retention window.

3) Logging & audit evidence:
- Audit logs (request metadata, user ids, token counts, routing decisions) retained per contract. Standard options: 90, 180, 365 days. For SOC2 / audit, we can produce access logs and a log schema (attached as kb-sccs-summary.pdf).

4) Subprocessors & residency:
- Typical subprocessors listed in our subprocessor register; common cloud providers include AWS (us-east-1, eu-west-1), GCP optional. We can provide a per-deal residency map and an on-premise/private deployment option for strict residency requirements.

5) DPA Annex specifics:
- We have a templated DPA annex that contains the export clause (SCCs), security controls, subprocessors, and audit access. I attached the DPA annex draft (redwood_dpa_annex_draft.docx) with comments on the export clause and an optional clause for data localization.

Attached: redwood_dpa_annex_draft.docx (word), kb-sccs-summary.pdf (pdf). I included short redline suggestions in the annex for the export assurances (highlighted).

If you want I can draft a short one-page TIA summary tailored to Nebula’s flows (PHI/identifiers) — that’s usually helpful for procurement.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Architect, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
